en: There were some technological issues when the Hispano cannon was converted to belt feed. Among them was the fact that the chamber width was 1/16 inch too large, which allowed backflow gases to enter the barrel and jam the breechlock. Reducing the size of the chamber width helped solve the problem and lessened the amount of weapon failures.
cn: 1942 年的西斯帕诺 Mk II 改进版。由于技术上的纰漏，西斯帕诺机炮在改为弹链供弹设计后将药室做宽了一些。这样一来，气体反流便很容易进入炮管，进而导致闩锁卡死。将药室宽度减小 1/16 英寸后，这种逆流效应明显缓解，并最终延长了故障间隔时间。

en: Modification of Hispano cannon mk.II (year 1943). Replacement of graphite lubricant with fluid lubrication. Using extractor spring of cantilever type. All this increased the weapon's reliability.
cn: 1943 年的西斯帕诺 Mk II 改进版。石墨润滑剂替换为液体润滑；抛壳弹簧改为悬臂式。由此，西斯帕诺机炮的可靠性进一步增强。

en: Replacing the propellers increases acceleration and maximum forward speed.
cn: 更换老旧的桨叶，从而提升最大前进航速和加速性能。

en: Cleaning the ship’s bottom from seashells and algae. Increases maximum forward speed.
cn: 在干船坞对舰船进行维护，清理船体上附着的贝类和海藻，从而提升最大前进航速。

en: Replacing the rudder blades and steering mechanisms. Increases the ship's turning ability and decreases its turning time and radius.
cn: 更换老旧的舵叶和转向结构，从而降低转向半径和耗时。

en: Damage control division training allows repair of damaged modules of a naval vessel more quickly and efficiently
cn: 对舰艇损管部门进行训练，提高对舰艇受损部位的维修效率

en: Fire division training allows fire extinguishing to a naval vessel more quickly
cn: 对舰上消防部门进行训练，加快扑灭舰艇火灾的效率

en: Augmented bilge pumps reduce the time required to pump the water out of the vessel.
cn: 增强船底水泵的性能，从而降低泵出船舱积水的耗时。

en: Increases the measurement accuracy of the distance to the enemy.
cn: 提升对敌方目标距离的测量精度。

en: An augmented targeting mechanism for main armament. Increases the turn speed of the main turrets.
cn: 增强主炮火控系统的性能，从而提升主炮炮塔转速。

en: An augmented targeting mechanism for auxiliary armament. Increases the turn speed of the auxiliary turrets.
cn: 增强副炮火控系统的性能，从而提升副炮炮塔转速。

en: An augmented targeting mechanism for anti-air armament. Increases the turn speed of the anti-air turrets.
cn: 增强防空武器火控系统的性能，从而提升防空武器炮塔转速。

en: Sandbags and gun shields for extra protection from fire and shrapnel.
cn: 布置额外的沙袋和炮盾，从而提升对火焰和弹片的防护性。

en: Protects the inside of the vessel from shrapnel.
cn: 提升舰船内部对弹片的防护性。

en: Replacing the gun liner reduces fire spread.
cn: 更换主炮的衬管，从而改善弹道散布。
